note: Port-led industrialisation database — the 14 Coastal Economic Zones identified in the National Perspective Plan (April 2016), Coastal Economic Units, and the documented state of the pillar. The critical verified finding: no project has been sanctioned for financial assistance under the port-led industrialisation pillar of the Sagarmala scheme (11 August 2026, Rajya Sabha reply), and no notified or developed CEZ appears in any Tier-1 source on file. Proposed zones are never described as operating clusters. Atlas industrial-node links are derived from the shared relationship layer, not asserted here.

pillar_status.text: No project has been sanctioned for financial assistance under the port-led industrialisation pillar of the Sagarmala scheme (Rajya Sabha reply, 11 August 2026); consistent with the absence of an industrialisation row in the July 2026 pillar-wise annexure. The 14 CEZ projects (₹55,887 crore) counted in the 839-project portfolio split are identified projects, not scheme-funded ones.

ceu_definition.text: Each CEZ consists of multiple Coastal Economic Units (CEUs), and more than one industrial cluster can be housed within a CEZ. To accelerate CEU development, locations like Kandla, Paradip, Ennore and Vizag were proposed as priorities where land parcels are available close to a deep-draught port with strong manufacturing potential. CEZs are spatial economic regions spread over multiple coastal districts with strong port linkage.

smart_industrial_port_cities.text: Introduced as a concept alongside CEZs, CEUs and Port-Linked Industrial & Maritime Clusters on the MoPSW division page; no specific project, cost or agency has been captured from a primary source.

hinterland_reading.text: The geography the CEZs were meant to capture already exists in partial form: petrochemicals at Dahej and Sikka, refining-steel at the Maharashtra coast, electronics at Sriperumbudur and Kopparthy served by Chennai/Kamarajar and Krishnapatnam. What the pillar has not delivered is the dedicated zone instrument — the land, utilities and single-window apparatus that would pull import-heavy processing to the waterfront.
If CEZs move to notified land, import-heavy processing (energy, chemicals, metals) is the most likely early mover. None is documented as a CEZ unit on file.
